headlines.description: — Rookie phenom Esmerlyn Valdez hit two home runs, including a go-ahead grand slam in the seventh inning, and drove in six runs to rally the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 7-6 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers on Saturday in the first game of a doubleheader.
headlines.shortLinkText: Esmerlyn Valdez's grand slam, two homers lead Pirates past Brewers 7-6 in first game of doubleheader

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Royce Lewis hit a two-run homer and sparked the go-ahead rally with a seventh-inning double Saturday as the Minnesota Twins beat the Los Angeles Angels 5-3.
headlines.shortLinkText: Royce Lewis homers, doubles to lead Twins over Angels 5-3

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Chase Meidroth hit an RBI double in the sixth inning, five pitchers combined on a four-hitter and the Chicago White Sox sent the Athletics to their eighth straight loss with a 1-0 victory Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chase Meidroth hits RBI double, White Sox win 1-0 and send Athletics to 8th straight loss

events.name: New York Yankees at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — Trent Grisham's two-run homer in of the eighth inning gave the Yankees another comeback victory over the Washington Nationals' bullpen, 4-2 on Saturday, giving Aaron Boone his 750th win as New York's manager.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yankees rally late again in Washington, this time with 4 in 8th for 4-2 victory and 3rd win in row

events.name: Colorado Rockies at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Tyler Mahle won for the first time since mid-April, Casey Schmitt hit a tiebreaking three-run homer in the sixth inning and the San Francisco Giants beat the Colorado Rockies 4-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahle gets first win since April and Schmitt hits go-ahead, 3-run homer as Giants beat Rockies 4-2

events.name: Boston Red Sox at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Andrew Monasterio and Masataka Yoshida hit two-run homers as the surging Boston Red Sox played after a night of normal rest and extended their winning streak to eight games with a 4-0 victory over the New York Mets on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Monasterio, Yoshida hit 2-run homers as Red Sox beat Mets 4-0 for 8-game winning streak

headlines.description: — Tanner Bibee threw 6 2/3 solid innings, Steven Kwan and Patrick Bailey hit two-run doubles and the Cleveland Guardians beat the Miami Marlins 4-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tanner Bibee, Guardians cool off Marlins with 4-1 win

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Ryan Vilade hit a three-run homer, Ben Williamson posted a career-best four hits and Jonathan Aranda had three more and an RBI to give Tampa Bay a 6-1 win over Seattle on Saturday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Vilade’s 3-run home run, Ben Williamson’s 4 hits lead Rays to a 6-1 victory over Mariners

headlines.description: — Esmerlyn Valdez hit his third home run of the day, and the Pittsburgh Pirates edged the NL Central-leading Milwaukee Brewers 3-2 on Saturday to sweep a doubleheader.
headlines.shortLinkText: Esmerlyn Valdez homers again as Pirates edge Brewers, 3-2, sweep twinbill from NL Central leaders

headlines.description: — Cristopher Sánchez struck out seven in seven innings, Bryce Harper and J.T. Realmuto doubled and the Philadelphia Phillies ended the Detroit Tigers' six-game winning streak with a 4-2 victory Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Phillies end the Tigers' winning streak at 6 with a 4-2 victory

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Kyle Bradish gave up one run and two hits in 6 2/3 innings, Pete Alonso hit a two-run homer, and the Baltimore Orioles beat the Kansas City Royals 6-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bradish pitches 6 2/3 innings, Orioles hit 4 homers to beat Royals 6-1

headlines.description: — Yordan Alvarez had another moonshot for his AL-leading 31st home run, LaMonte Wade Jr. hit his first...
headlines.shortLinkText: Alvarez hits AL-leading 31st homer, Wade has first career grand slam and Astros beat Rangers 9-3

headlines.description: — Alex Bregman hit a two-run homer in the seventh inning and the Chicago Cubs rallied for a 5-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bregman's 2-run homer in the 7th propels the Cubs to a 5-3 victory over the Reds

events.name: Atlanta Braves at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Lars Nootbaar hit a three-run home run and later scored a run, leading the St. Louis Cardinals to a 4-1 victory over the Atlanta Braves on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nootbaar, Liberatore spark Cardinals to 4-1 win over the Braves

headlines.description: — Ty France hit the go-ahead home run, Sung-Mun Song and Manny Machado each drove in two runs and the San Diego Padres beat the Toronto Blue Jays 8-7 on Saturday night to even the three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: France hits go-ahead homer, Padres beat Blue Jays 8-7

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — James McCann hit his first two home runs of the season and had four RBI, Brandon Pfaadt made it three wins in three starts since returning to the rotation, and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 9-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: James McCann hits two home runs as Diamondbacks thump Dodgers 9-2
